title: Organizations not-found, AWS JSON 1.1, __type without a namespace
why: The ordinary JSON 1.1 shape: no awsQueryError, so the modeled shape and the wire code are the same string, and __type carries it bare. An SDK that models the error mints an exception class of the same name, which is the fourth surface rule 1 lists.

body.message: You specified a policy that doesn't exist.

expect.name: a clause naming the shape, matched against the body
the same clause, matched against the SDK's exception class
a near miss on the shape
